newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai metals exchange says to reveal stocks.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai metals exchange says to reveal stocks.

text.p: The Shanghai Metals Exchange expects to announce in November registered stockpiles held by its members, an exchange official said on Tuesday.
The exchange had been pushed by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to make its stockpiles more transparent, said Gu Jianxing, manager of the metals exchange's information department.
"We should be able to announce stocks next month," he told a metals conference in Beijing.
Stockpile transparency was difficult because the exchange did not have its own warehouse yet and stocks were held alongside non-exchange metals.
Metals traders and industry players in China have long complained that the country's two metals futures exchanges do not reveal their stockpiles, saying it adds to market uncertainty.
